tooltip.createch2.food.ae2.interface: Food slots refill from compatible stored batches. New crafting waits until the slot is empty; food dates are never reset.
tooltip.createch2.food.ae2.pattern: Pattern previews do not age. Actual food keeps its TFC age and nutrition; fresh/rotten recipe rules still apply.
tooltip.createch2.food.liquifier.input: Chemical-age sterilization: fresh TFC meals with grain, vegetables and protein.
tooltip.createch2.food.liquifier.yield: Paste yield is limited by calories and the least abundant required nutrient; vessels are returned.
tooltip.createch2.food.liquifier.rotten: Rotten food cannot be processed into fresh paste.
tooltip.createch2.food.paste.diet: Sterile TFC rations supply grain, vegetables and protein. Fruit, dairy and drinking water remain separate needs.
tooltip.createch2.food.flesh.blood: Native blood fuels each TFC protein portion; an empty source supplies no food.
tooltip.createch2.food.canning.input: Cans retain ingredient nutrition, age and return vessels. Effect foods cannot start a batch; canning does not cure rot.
tooltip.createch2.food.canning.nutrition: Nutrition comes from the canned ingredients. Old cans with no ingredient record supply no invented nutrient groups.

research.createch2.sci_01_empirical_meth: Establish a Copper-era laboratory and repeatable evidence handling.
research.createch2.sci_02_peer_review.de: Standardize shared-team review and reproducible industrial claims.
research.createch2.sci_03_systems_engine: Coordinate computation, power and process evidence across departments.
research.createch2.sci_04_megaproject_go: Certify evidence and controls for civilization-scale experiments.
research.createch2.mat_01_bronze_metallu: Control copper-tin melts and repeatable bronze casting.
research.createch2.mat_02_brass_engineer: Develop controlled zinc-copper alloys for precision structures.
research.createch2.mat_03_space_aluminum: Reduce extraterrestrial bauxite into certified light alloys.
research.createch2.mat_04_titanium_chlor: Qualify chloride conversion and hot titanium sponge handling.
research.createch2.mat_05_vacuum_titaniu: Refine reactive titanium under controlled high vacuum.
research.createch2.mat_06_platinum_group: Separate returned mineral concentrates into platinum, iridium, palladium and osmium. Prove the refinery before scaling to seeded batches, then mill refined osmium into mechanical stock.
research.createch2.mat_07_superconductor: Produce and qualify cryogenic zero-resistance conductors.
research.createch2.mat_08_extreme_struct: Engineer matter-compatible containment and high-field structures.
research.createch2.mec_01_rotary_mechani: Measure shafts, cranks and water-driven rotary work.
research.createch2.mec_02_automated_mani: Apply repeatable deployment, pressing and articulated handling.
research.createch2.mec_03_steel_mechanis: Build mechanisms and casings rated for heavy industry.
research.createch2.mec_04_rolling_system: Standardize powered rolling and heavy rail forming.
research.createch2.mec_05_precision_mech: Integrate precision actuation, servos and gyro controls.
research.createch2.thm_01_boiler_science: Quantify steam generation and bronze pressure vessels.
research.createch2.thm_03_high_pressure_: Operate vacuum, implosion, decompression and high-pressure processes.
research.createch2.pre_01_precision_mech: Qualify repeatable golden-sheet mechanisms inside the early Create factory.
research.createch2.pre_02_machine_instru: Calibrate thermal probes, trace recorders and shaft-linked machine behavior.
research.createch2.pre_03_electronic_met: Calibrate digital sensors and controlled actuators.
research.createch2.pre_04_nanoscale_fabr: Qualify nanometer-scale circuits and component processes.
research.createch2.pre_03b_standardized_: Rebuild proven industrial modules from versioned standards without automating their utilities or commissioning.
research.createch2.pre_05_metrology.desc: Measure quantum-scale fields against traceable standards.
research.createch2.pre_06_field_manufact: Coordinate spacecraft-grade materials, computation, and ruggedized field hardware.
research.createch2.che_01_process_contro: Establish controlled fluid separation and petroleum handling.
research.createch2.che_02_electrolysis.d: Establish laboratory vessels, brine electrolysis and controlled practical acids.
research.createch2.che_03_synthetic_poly: Turn refinery aromatics into epoxy, engineered polymers and carbon-fiber composites.
research.createch2.che_04_advanced_separ: Use qualified Chemica liners, seals and electrodes to enter Mekanism pressure chemistry.
research.createch2.che_05_reaction_engin: Control multi-input reactions and pressurized conversion.
research.createch2.che_07_extreme_purity: Crystallize and assay matter at extreme purity.
Turn ore observations into reproducible survey records.
research.createch2.geo_02_mechanized_ext: Apply powered survey data to repeatable quarrying.
research.createch2.geo_03_deep_extractio: Model and operate deep crustal extraction systems.
research.createch2.geo_04_planetary_reso: Correlate planetary surveys, mission telemetry, computation, and bounded extraction data.
research.createch2.env_01_emissions_cont: Measure and vent early industrial pollution responsibly.
research.createch2.env_02_industrial_scr: Monitor and actively manage high-output pollution systems.
research.createch2.rsr_01_resource_simul: Model renewable extraction without bypassing first discovery.
research.createch2.ele_01_practical_elec: Establish safe conductors, connectors and measurable low-voltage circuits.
research.createch2.ele_02_electromechani: Convert between rotary work and controlled electrical power.
research.createch2.ele_03_industrial_pow: Scale generation, storage and switching for industrial loads.
research.createch2.ele_04_high_energy_gr: Extend the protected physical grid with returned-material manufacturing, transformers, insulation and high-energy service. Digital supervision comes later and does not block safe advanced electric service.
research.createch2.ele_05_extreme_power_: Synchronize high-field energy conversion with quantum loads.
research.createch2.com_01_analog_logic.d: Build and validate analog control circuits.
research.createch2.com_02_programmable_c: Deploy programmable computers and alarms for industrial control.
research.createch2.com_03_networked_cont: Coordinate wired computers, peripherals and industrial telemetry.
research.createch2.com_04_digital_fabric: Use encoded storage and automated digital fabrication.
research.createch2.com_05_distributed_co: Scale advanced computers and automated remote work.
research.createch2.com_06_quantum_comput: Qualify quantum processors and nonlocal storage links.
research.createch2.log_01_material_handl: Measure repeatable routing, schedules and transfer operations.
research.createch2.log_02_railway_engine: Standardize track control and railway infrastructure.
research.createch2.log_03_locomotive_sys: Integrate steam locomotive structures and schedules.
research.createch2.log_04_extraplanetary: Coordinate vehicle routing between atmosphere and orbit.
research.createch2.air_01_lighter_than_a: Control buoyant craft with mechanical propulsion and steering.
research.createch2.air_02_powered_airfra: Build powered airframes after locomotive systems and industrial process control. Rail freight, petroleum, insulation and measured electrical service remain the suppliers of convenient flight.
research.createch2.air_03_long_range_air: Stabilize vector thrust and gyroscopic long-range flight.
research.createch2.spc_01_propulsion_ins: Instrument thrust systems before committing to a launch vehicle.
research.createch2.spc_02_low_voltage_ro: Develop low-voltage cabling, storage and engine fans for rocketry.
research.createch2.spc_03_propellant_ref: Refine and qualify rocket propellants under controlled conditions.
research.createch2.spc_04_integrated_lau: Integrate engines, fins, launch pads and airframes into a rocket.
research.createch2.spc_05_planetary_oper: Operate life support, water systems and surface vehicles off-world.
research.createch2.spc_06_advanced_space: Turn returned desh, tharsite and aluminum into advanced casings, hulls, lubricated motors and pumps. This is the terrestrial factory payoff from First Space.
research.createch2.spc_07_orbital_contro: Model attitude control, staging and orbital maneuvering.
research.createch2.spc_08_heavy_rocket_p: Engineer titanium nozzles and sustained orbital thrust.
research.createch2.spc_09_deep_space_nav: Fuse orbital mission experience with computation, logistics, and geological navigation models.
research.createch2.spc_10_booster_system: Coordinate high-thrust booster assemblies and digital guidance.
research.createch2.spc_11_reusable_orbit: Unify airship logistics and rocket propulsion into reusable craft.
research.createch2.spc_12_interstellar_e: Apply frontier metrology to the final propulsion architecture.
research.createch2.nuc_01_radiation_metr: Measure exposure during First Space expeditions. Instruments precede nuclear machinery; isotope processing and fuel-cycle hardware retain their later chemistry and materials gates.
research.createch2.nuc_02_isotope_separa: Separate and assay fissile isotopes under controlled conditions.
research.createch2.nuc_03_fission_fuel_c: Prepare, load and control certified fission fuel assemblies.
research.createch2.nuc_04_reactor_instru: Instrument fission structures, waste handling and control logic.
research.createch2.nuc_05_fusion_fuels.d: Close the controlled nuclear fuel cycle through waste recovery, reprocessing and plutonium preparation. These mature nuclear outputs prepare the later fusion program.
research.createch2.nuc_06_controlled_fus: Assemble and operate a governed fusion reactor system.
research.createch2.mtr_01_equivalence_pr: Test repeatable equivalence between matter and stored value.
research.createch2.mtr_02_transmutation_: Formalize covalence and philosophical transmutation models.
research.createch2.mtr_03_encoded_transm: Encode stable transmutation and condenser operations.
research.createch2.mtr_04_matter_replica: Stabilize singularity-derived matter for controlled replication.
research.createch2.frn_01_remote_observa: Design autonomous instruments for hostile distant environments.
research.createch2.frn_02_expeditionary_: Combine field logistics and propulsion into a frontier expedition.
research.createch2.frn_03_frontier_obser: Recover and certify direct observations from frontier environments.
research.createch2.frn_04_spacetime_engi: Reconstruct a working Stargate from earned planetary archaeology, fusion and quantum control. Its transfer crystals also authorize mature Ender Storage item/fluid links.
research.createch2.frn_05_exotic_particl: Return trinium through the reconstructed Stargate, combine it with the PGM and quantum-control industries, then form and operate the particle accelerator on the Naquadah/ZPM floor.
research.createch2.frn_06_reality_engine: Converge exotic physics, controlled replication and ESO-04 Occult Synthesis into reality engineering and Neutronium/UHV mechanics. Esoteric study becomes required for full Infinity completion.
research.createch2.eso_01_botanical_obse: Record repeatable properties of occult plants and preparations.
research.createch2.eso_02_ritual_apparat: Build controlled distillation, spinning and ritual preparation tools.
research.createch2.eso_03_attunement.des: Standardize attuned stones, chalk and altar construction.
research.createch2.eso_04_occult_synthes: Correlate esoteric practice with computation and frontier observations.
research.createch2.che_05b_precision_ben: Turn graded tetrahedrite into a controlled copper-bearing chemical stream.
research.createch2.mil_01_organized_defe: Turn field observations and primitive projectile use into repeatable defensive doctrine.
research.createch2.mil_02_metallurgical_: Apply controlled metallurgy and mechanisms to standardized TaCZ infantry arms.
research.createch2.mil_03_industrial_ord: Combine steel, explosive chemistry and Create tooling into repeatable ammunition and artillery production.
research.createch2.mil_04_instrumented_b: Apply precision measurement and networked control to infantry support, sonar and recorded firing solutions.
research.createch2.mil_05_automated_defe: Integrate radar, interceptors, shields and supervised computation into defended infrastructure.
research.createch2.mil_06_strategic_dete: Apply an established nuclear civilization to controlled strategic-weapon manufacture.
research.createch2.mil_07_exotic_threat_: Apply frontier, fusion and esoteric physics to the defense of civilization-scale infrastructure.

research.createch2.frn_04c_dimensional_f: Model the high-energy containment behavior preserved in the Venusian ruins.
research.createch2.frn_04d_address_geome: Resolve point-of-origin and stellar-coordinate logic from the Mercurian relay.
research.createch2.frn_04f_eighth_chevro: Prove a stable intergalactic address using Tollan records and extreme-power control.
